CheckTitle: [DEPRECATED] ECR registry with Basic Scanning without scan on push enabled
Description: ECR Registry found with Basic Scanning enabled.
Risk: Basic Scanning allows for manual initiation of image scans, while 'scan on push' automatically triggers scans whenever new container images are pushed to the registry.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure scan on push is enabled for ECR registries.

Notes: DEPRECATED in favor of registry-level scan configurations: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/containers/container-scanning-updates-in-amazon-ecr-private-registries-using-amazon-inspector
